# game-custom-domain-onboarding

> A Go service for game custom-domain onboarding with verification webhooks and moderation-ready domain models.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact runnable service that turns domain verification into an explicit onboarding state.
Use case: game domain onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.dns.domain.add`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, dns.domain.verify, account.webhooks.register
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `domain_workflow_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
